{{Quote|This assignment comes from General Durant. You remember him don't you, Rusk?''"<br />"''We survived the Geonosis campaign together.''"<br />"''That's one way of putting it.|General Callan Grayne and Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Price of Victory" />}}
The '''Geonosis campaign''' was a conflict during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> that occurred sometime between [[3665 BBY]]<ref name="date" /> and the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline" /> A [[Fideltin Rusk's first squad|squad]] of Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] including [[Fideltin Rusk]] and [[Callan Grayne]] served in the campaign on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] alongside a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Durant]],<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> who would become a [[General/Legends|general]] and a member of the [[Republic Strategic High Command]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the war.<ref name="General Durant">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|General Durant|Taris}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Geonosis campaign was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. It was mentioned during the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-class mission "The Price of Victory" on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> though the character of Durant is a target pursued by [[Sith Warrior]] class players on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="General Durant" />
